content: 2026 AI SRE consensus table stakes: human-in-the-loop approvals/RBAC/audit trails; final structured artifact (summary+evidence chain+remediation) not a chat transcript; evidence links required per diagnosis, summary-only outputs blocked; parallel hypothesis testing across deploys/infra/dependencies; human retains scope/trust/postmortem decisions; full reasoning-chain tracing now table stakes (89% of orgs have agent observability vs 52% evals); postmortem export to Jira/Confluence increasingly expected.
